newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly steady but gas oil slips.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly steady but gas oil slips.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly steady on Wednesday, traders said.
Gasoline was steady to slightly higher. Barges stayed quiet with more focus on U.S. arbitrage deals.
Naphtha swaps were unchanged but physical bids edged up. Traders said local supplies were ample.
Gas oil prices and spot differentials weakened further on Wednesday but despite the losses and a shallower IPE futures backwardation, buyers were reluctant to be drawn out.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were unchanged from Tuesday, with trades as high as $99 fob ARA.
